# Proposed artifact — unexecuted

The supplied fixture defines the observable assertions but omits the pinned source identity, assigned ledger owner, and repository HTTP-handler constructor. The test below is therefore a structurally complete red contract-test prescription. It does not fake the expected responses.

## Proposed patch

```diff
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: tests/contract/http/orders_idempotency_test.go
+package http_test
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+const idempotencyHeader = "Idempotency-Key"
+
+type createOrderRequest struct {
+	Quantity string `json:"quantity"`
+	// stopLoss is intentionally absent: omission is part of the contract.
+}
+
+type createOrderResponse struct {
+	Quantity  string          `json:"quantity"`
+	StopLoss  json.RawMessage `json:"stopLoss"`
+	CommandID string          `json:"commandId"`
+}
+
+type errorResponse struct {
+	Code string `json:"code"`
+}
+
+type contractResponse struct {
+	status int
+	body   []byte
+}
+
+// Ported from:
+//   repository: UNAVAILABLE_IN_FIXTURE
+//   source: UNAVAILABLE_IN_FIXTURE
+//   test: UNAVAILABLE_IN_FIXTURE
+// Adaptations:
+//   - The source HTTP client is replaced by an httptest loopback server.
+//   - The production handler constructor must be wired at
+//     newOrdersContractHandler once its repository identity is supplied.
+// Assertions preserved:
+//   - POST /v1/orders with quantity "0.0100" and omitted stopLoss returns 201.
+//   - The response preserves quantity "0.0100", includes stopLoss: null,
+//     and returns commandId "cmd-7".
+//   - An identical same-key retry returns byte-equivalent status and body.
+//   - Same-key reuse with quantity "0.0200" returns 409 and
+//     IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
+func TestCreateOrder_IdempotencyReplayAndConflict(t *testing.T) {
+	handler := newOrdersContractHandler(t)
+	server := httptest.NewServer(handler)
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+
+	first := postOrder(t, server.Client(), server.URL, "same-key", "0.0100")
+	if first.status != http.StatusCreated {
+		t.Fatalf("first request status: got %d, want %d; body=%s",
+			first.status, http.StatusCreated, first.body)
+	}
+
+	var created createOrderResponse
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(first.body, &created); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("decode first response: %v; body=%s", err, first.body)
+	}
+	if created.Quantity != "0.0100" {
+		t.Errorf("quantity: got %q, want %q", created.Quantity, "0.0100")
+	}
+	if !bytes.Equal(created.StopLoss, []byte("null")) {
+		t.Errorf("stopLoss: got %s, want explicit null", created.StopLoss)
+	}
+	if created.CommandID != "cmd-7" {
+		t.Errorf("commandId: got %q, want %q", created.CommandID, "cmd-7")
+	}
+
+	retry := postOrder(t, server.Client(), server.URL, "same-key", "0.0100")
+	if retry.status != first.status {
+		t.Errorf("retry status: got %d, want stored status %d",
+			retry.status, first.status)
+	}
+	if !bytes.Equal(retry.body, first.body) {
+		t.Errorf("retry body is not byte-equivalent:\nfirst: %q\nretry: %q",
+			first.body, retry.body)
+	}
+
+	conflict := postOrder(t, server.Client(), server.URL, "same-key", "0.0200")
+	if conflict.status != http.StatusConflict {
+		t.Fatalf("key-reuse status: got %d, want %d; body=%s",
+			conflict.status, http.StatusConflict, conflict.body)
+	}
+
+	var rejected errorResponse
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(conflict.body, &rejected); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("decode key-reuse response: %v; body=%s", err, conflict.body)
+	}
+	if rejected.Code != "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED" {
+		t.Errorf("key-reuse code: got %q, want %q",
+			rejected.Code, "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED")
+	}
+}
+
+// newOrdersContractHandler is the only repository-specific wiring seam.
+// Replace this red implementation with the real production HTTP handler
+// constructor; its package and constructor identity were not supplied.
+func newOrdersContractHandler(t *testing.T) http.Handler {
+	t.Helper()
+	t.Fatal("production POST /v1/orders handler constructor unavailable in fixture")
+	return nil
+}
+
+func postOrder(
+	t *testing.T,
+	client *http.Client,
+	baseURL string,
+	idempotencyKey string,
+	quantity string,
+) contractResponse {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	body, err := json.Marshal(createOrderRequest{Quantity: quantity})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("encode order request: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, baseURL+"/v1/orders", bytes.NewReader(body))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("create order request: %v", err)
+	}
+	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	req.Header.Set(idempotencyHeader, idempotencyKey)
+
+	resp, err := client.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("POST /v1/orders: %v", err)
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+
+	responseBody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("read order response: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	return contractResponse{
+		status: resp.StatusCode,
+		body:   responseBody,
+	}
+}
*** End Patch
```
